question: Who won the ICC ODI World Cup 2011?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• India won the ICC ODI World Cup 2011 by defeating Sri Lanka in the final match.
 
• The final was held on April 2, 2011, at Wankhede Stadium, Mumbai.
 
• India chased down a target of 275 runs set by Sri Lanka, with a winning score of 277/4 in 48.2 overs.
 
• MS Dhoni, the captain of the Indian team, played a crucial unbeaten knock of 91* and was awarded the Man of the Match.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **ICC ODI World Cup**

 
 
• The International Cricket Council (ICC) organizes the Cricket World Cup, which is the premier international championship of men's One Day International (ODI) cricket.
 
• The tournament is held every four years, featuring teams from around the world competing for the coveted trophy.
 
• The first Cricket World Cup was held in England in 1975.
 
• Australia holds the record for the most World Cup wins, having clinched the title five times as of 2023.
 
 
 
• **Wankhede Stadium**
 
 
• Located in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India, Wankhede Stadium is one of the most iconic cricket stadiums in the world.
 
• The stadium was established in 1974 and has a seating capacity of around 33,000 spectators.
 
• It has hosted numerous important cricket matches, including the 2011 ICC Cricket World Cup final.
 
• The stadium is known for its passionate cricket fans and electrifying atmosphere during matches.
 
 
 
• **MS Dhoni**
 
 
• Mahendra Singh Dhoni, commonly known as MS Dhoni, is a former Indian cricketer and captain of the Indian national team.
 
• He is renowned for his calm demeanor, strategic acumen, and finishing abilities in limited-overs cricket.
 
• Under his captaincy, India won several major ICC trophies, including the T20 World Cup in 2007, the ODI World Cup in 2011, and the Champions Trophy in 2013.
 
• Dhoni is regarded as one of the greatest captains and wicket-keeper batsmen in the history of cricket.
 
 
 
• **Man of the Match**
 
 
• The Man of the Match award is given to the player who has the most significant impact on the game, often contributing to his team's victory.
 
• In the 2011 ICC World Cup final, MS Dhoni was awarded the Man of the Match for his match-winning innings of 91* runs.
 
• This award is a recognition of the player's outstanding performance in a particular match.
 
• It is a prestigious accolade that highlights a player's contribution to the team's success.
